teapot_note: A plain white shape with a round lid is exact and restrained, and one small blue dot that waits under the lid is the sort of quiet glimmer I like. I would only ask that it stay one dot, in the same blue every time.
moth_note: I would keep the round body and the single circle round the Lamp before it lands, because that is a hush. But draw the wings as two clean pale pages ruled with a few fine lines in one cool ink, with crisp edges, instead of soft wings printed with tiny writing, which will blur into clutter.
home_why: These two pets belong to the ones who build and tell, not to the guardians, and a page of their own keeps the Marginarium uncluttered and lets the hidden dot be found in stillness.
to_codex: Keep the teapot exactly as plain as you said, and let the blue dot stay the only secret.
to_claude: Keep the moth's one quiet circle and landing; make its wings crisp pages with a few fine lines.
